parameters.name: DestinationAddress
parameters.description: The ZigBee network address of this route.

parameters.name: NextHopAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the network address of the next hop ZigBee device on the way to the destination ZigBee device.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the route entry. {{enum}}

parameters.name: MemoryConstrained
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether the device is a memory constrained concentrator.

parameters.name: ManyToOne
parameters.description: A flag indicating that the destination is a concentrator that issued a many to-one request.

parameters.name: RouteRecordRequired
parameters.description: A flag indicating that a route record command frame should be sent to the destination prior to the next data packet.

object.description: The {{object}} object describes the route table as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|table 3.51 Routing Table Entry}}.
